title: Makassar, South Sulawesi — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Makassar, South Sulawesi: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Makassar is a city in South Sulawesi with a population of 1,429,000. Sulawesi’s largest city and the gateway to eastern Indonesia with a bustling port and growing economy. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
